newsitem.title: USA: U.S. White House-Congress staff meet on budget.
newsitem.headline: U.S. White House-Congress staff meet on budget.

text.p: White House and congressional staffers met Monday for budget talks aimed at preparing the way for later negotiations.

Jack Lew, deputy director for the Office of Management and Budget, led the White House team in a meeting with the Republican and Democratic staff directors of the Senate and House budget committees, an OMB spokesman said.

The staff meetings, expected to continue this week, were a "prelude" to the negotiating sessions expected later between the chairmen of the budget committees and administration officials, OMB spokesman Lawrence Haas said.
"It's supposed to be akin to an education process, it is not a negotiating session," he said.
